def test_01_verify_the_screen_when_user_clicks_on_the_create_your_own_shortcut_arrow_button_in_add_new_shortcuts_screen_C46(self):
        """
        Verify the screen.
        TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/46
        """
        self.fc.reset_app()
        self.fc.flow_load_home_screen(skip_value_prop=False)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn()
        self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_printer_device_card()
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_shortcuts_tile(raise_e=False)
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_shortcuts_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_add_new_shortcut_btn()
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()

        Steps:
            1.Install and Launch the HPX app.
            2.Click on the printer icon on the root view screen.
            3.Then click on the shortcuts tile on the device details page.
            4.Click on the Add new shortcuts in shortcuts screen.
            5.Then click on the Create your own shortcut arrow button.
            6.Navigate 'Add save' screen.
            7.Click on the 'Sign in' link of any cloud accounts in Add save screen.
            8.Verify the behavior.
        Expected Result:
            User should be able to signed in with the desired cloud accounts.
        """
        self.fc.reset_app()
        self.fc.flow_load_home_screen(skip_value_prop=False)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn()
        self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_printer_device_card()
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_shortcuts_tile(raise_e=False)
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_shortcuts_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_add_new_shortcut_btn()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_create_your_own_shortcut()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_edit_shortcut_continue_btn()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_save_shortcut_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_google_drive_signin_link()

automation_scripts_rules.description: Implicit Step Injection Rule for Test Environment Prerequisites
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test cases requiring application reset, device setup, or environment initialization not explicitly stated in manual test steps
rule_definition: WHEN: Test execution requires technical prerequisites (application reset, device addition, environment setup) that are assumed but not documented in manual test steps
THEN: Inject implicit steps with clear identification as 'Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution' and implement before any explicit test steps

IMPLEMENTATION: Always include application reset (self.fc.reset_app()) as first step, add device setup steps when printer interaction required, implement with detailed intermediary steps covering identification, execution, and verification phases

automation_scripts_rules.description: Supporting Step Integration Rule for Test Case Validation
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test cases requiring validation evidence, screen verification, or test purpose confirmation
rule_definition: WHEN: Test execution requires validation steps that support the test case purpose but are not primary test actions (screen title verification, validation confirmation)
THEN: Integrate supporting steps identified as 'Implicit Step – Supporting Step – Purpose of Test Case Validation' after relevant primary actions

IMPLEMENTATION: Include screen verification steps after navigation actions (verify_shortcuts_screen_title, verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title), implement with intermediary steps covering element location, visibility verification, text validation, and screen load confirmation

automation_scripts_rules.description: One-to-Many Mapping Rule for Complex Test Steps
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that involve multiple technical operations or require breakdown into sub-actions
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step involves application launch with multiple phases (reset + load), device setup with multiple operations (add device + search by IP), or any action requiring distinct preparation and execution phases
THEN: Split into multiple script lines with arrow notation (→) indicating sequence, implement each part with dedicated intermediary steps

IMPLEMENTATION: Use pattern 'script_line_1 → script_line_2' in mapped_script_line field, ensure each script line has complete intermediary steps covering its specific responsibility, maintain execution order through intermediary step prerequisites

automation_scripts_rules.description: Screen Navigation and Verification Pattern Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test steps involving navigation to screens or verification of screen display
rule_definition: WHEN: Test step requires navigating to a screen or verifying screen content
THEN: Implement verification method calls (verify_add_save_shortcut_title, verify_shortcuts_screen_title) with comprehensive validation

IMPLEMENTATION: Use verify_* method pattern for screen validation, include intermediary steps for element location, visibility check, text content validation, cloud account options verification (where applicable), and complete screen load confirmation

automation_scripts_rules.description: Element Interaction with Exception Handling Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps involving clicking on UI elements that may have interaction challenges
rule_definition: WHEN: Test step involves clicking on elements that may require special handling (tiles, buttons, links)
THEN: Implement click methods with appropriate exception handling parameters (raise_e=False where needed)

IMPLEMENTATION: Use click method pattern with exception suppression for elements that may have timing or interaction issues, include intermediary steps for screen verification, element location, clickability verification, click execution, and transition waiting

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases with specific validation objectives like 'Verify the screen when user click on Sign in link of any cloud accounts'
rule_definition: WHEN: Executing test cases that verify specific user interactions and resulting screen behavior
THEN: Include implicit supporting steps that validate the test case purpose even if not explicitly mentioned in manual test steps

IMPLEMENTATION: For sign-in link verification test cases, include screen title verifications after each navigation step, implement continue button clicks when required for screen progression, ensure final verification step captures and validates the expected behavior

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation scripts to ensure correct execution order based on application workflow
rule_definition: WHEN: Executing automation scripts with multiple steps that depend on previous step completion
THEN: Follow strict sequential order: application reset → launch → device setup → navigation → interaction → verification

IMPLEMENTATION: Implement intermediary steps with clear prerequisites, ensure each step validates previous step completion, use explicit waits for screen transitions, include verification steps to confirm each phase completion before proceeding to next phase

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All script lines to ensure complete implementation guidance
rule_definition: WHEN: Defining intermediary steps for any automation script line
THEN: Include detailed steps covering identification/location, verification/validation, execution/action, and confirmation/logging phases

IMPLEMENTATION: Each script line must have intermediary steps that provide complete implementation guidance including element identification methods, verification of element state, execution of intended action, waiting for results, and confirmation of successful completion

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that require verifying application behavior or response
